MATCH (p:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WHERE l.seconds>0 AND l.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-07-01T00:00:00Z') AND l.loggedAt<datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z')
WITH p, sum(l.seconds) AS total, count(DISTINCT pr) AS np
WHERE np>=2
WITH p.personKey AS id, total AS value ORDER BY value DESC
WITH collect({id:id,value:value}) AS rows
WITH rows, rows[4].value AS cut
UNWIND rows AS r
WITH r WHERE cut IS NULL OR r.value>=cut
RETURN r.id AS id, r.value AS value ORDER BY value DESC

MATCH (p:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WHERE l.seconds>0 AND l.loggedAt>=datetime('2009-07-01T00:00:00Z') AND l.loggedAt<datetime('2009-10-01T00:00:00Z')
WITH p, collect({i:i.issueKey,pr:pr.projectKey,h:l.historyId}) AS es, sum(l.seconds) AS total, count(DISTINCT pr) AS np
WHERE np>=2
ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5
UNWIND es AS e
RETURN p.personKey AS person, e.i AS issue, e.pr AS project, e.h AS te
